name: share-document-publicly
why: the emulation's public share: ModifyDocumentPermission with permissionType Share and accountIdsToAdd ["All"], a successful call (no errorCode)
source: recorded shape: detections/cloud/fixtures/trr9021/attack.json record #4 (the TRR9021 SSM procedure), unchanged

name: share-document-publicly-denied
why: the same public share, refused (AccessDenied): CloudTrail writes errorCode only on a failed call, and the document stays private, so filter_failed alone suppresses it; its null guard (sel_no_error_code) must read the same field
source: synthetic: derived from share-document-publicly; a failed call keeps its requestParameters and adds errorCode and errorMessage (CloudTrail record contents, errorCode 'Optional: True')

events.errorMessage: User: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/trr9021-operator is not authorized to perform: ssm:ModifyDocumentPermission on resource: arn:aws:ssm:us-east-1:123456789012:document/trr9021-doc

name: share-document-publicly-lower-case-all
why: a public share whose element is all in lower case: the API model accepts the word all in any letter case, so the rule must not need the letter case of All (a successful call, no errorCode)
source: synthetic: derived from share-document-publicly with the element all in lower case. The API model of SSM gives each element of AccountIdsToAdd the pattern (?i)all|[0-9]{12}: shape AccountId of ssm 2014-11-06 in aws/api-models-aws (commit 46135f8, models/ssm/service/2014-11-06/ssm-2014-11-06.json) and in botocore (commit e250abb, botocore/data/ssm/2014-11-06/service-2.json). That CloudTrail keeps the letter case of the request: not verified
